reason: Retain a surviving calendar origin when appointment details hand off to the editor; closing a clean or discarded editor restores keyboard focus without keeping two modals open. Creation retains its own opener; pending and dirty guards remain.

title.en: Return to the appointment after editing

summary.en: Keyboard focus returns to the calendar appointment when its editor closes.
summary.ar: يعود تركيز لوحة المفاتيح إلى موعد التقويم عند إغلاق محرره.

details.en: The editor preserves pending-save and unsaved-change protections while returning to a control that remains on the page.
details.ar: يحافظ المحرر على حماية الحفظ والتغييرات غير المحفوظة ويعود إلى عنصر ما زال موجودًا بالصفحة.
